01The record underneath

Each arrival above is backed by a durable entity or edge from this run. The short ids in the instrument are completed here.

One honest distinction. The dotted Space connector represents the entities’ shared spaceId; it is not a registered edge. working_on, attached_to, anchored_to, and authored_from are registered edges returned by the live graph.

02What the replay proves

A task is durable before anyone starts. Spawning a session adds liveness without replacing the task. Context joins through attached_to. When the worker answers, the server creates a message entity, anchors it to the task, and records the session it was authored from.

The conversation does not describe the graph from outside. It becomes part of the graph.
